title: Employment Agreement - Chief Operating Officer - Sablewood Senior Living Partners, LLC (with Exhibit A form of Separation Agreement and Release)
fictional_notice: All parties and facts are invented.

defects.title: Eighteen-month, fifty-mile post-employment noncompete
defects.why: Section 9.2 bars the executive, who is an employee and not a seller of a business, from working for or owning any senior living operator within fifty miles of a Community for eighteen months after termination. A noncompete in an employment contract is void and unlawful to include.
quotes: For eighteen (18) months after the Date of Termination, the Executive shall not own, manage, operate, consult for or be employed by any person that owns or operates an assisted living, memory care or independent living community located within fifty (50) miles of any Community.

defects.title: Assignment of own-time, unrelated developments with waiver of statutory limit and no notice
defects.why: Section 8.2 extends the assignment to developments made on the executive's own time, with the executive's own equipment, without Company information and unrelated to the business, and has the executive waive any law limiting the assignment; no written notice of the statutory exclusion is given. The assignment cannot apply to those inventions.
quotes: This assignment extends to Developments that the Executive creates on the Executive's own time, with the Executive's own equipment and without Proprietary Information, and that do not relate to the business of the Company Group, and the Executive waives the benefit of any law that would limit its scope.

defects.title: No reimbursement of personal vehicle costs for required travel between Communities
defects.why: Schedule A, Part 3 requires the executive to use a personal vehicle for work travel, deems the cost included in salary and bars any claim for mileage, fuel, tolls or parking. The employer must reimburse necessary business expenses and a waiver of that right is void.
quotes: The Base Salary is deemed to include full payment for all costs of that use, and the Executive is not entitled to, and will not submit any claim for, mileage, fuel, tolls, parking or other vehicle costs.

defects.title: Final wages payable within thirty days after termination
defects.why: Section 6.1 gives the Company thirty days after the Date of Termination to pay earned salary, earned incentive and vacation pay. Earned wages are due immediately on discharge and within 72 hours on resignation without notice.
quotes: The Company will pay all earned and unpaid Base Salary, Annual Incentive and vacation pay within thirty (30) days after the Date of Termination.

defects.title: Repayment of three months of paid salary on resignation in first year
defects.why: Section 4.3 requires the executive to pay back an amount equal to three months of Base Salary already paid if the executive resigns in the first year, labelled as recruitment cost recovery. An employer may not collect back any part of wages already paid.
quotes: If the Executive resigns for any reason before the first anniversary of the Start Date, the Executive shall pay the Company, as reimbursement of its recruitment costs, an amount equal to three (3) months of the Base Salary previously paid to the Executive.

defects.title: Earned salary and earned incentive paid only in exchange for a release
defects.why: Exhibit A, paragraph 2 makes earned, unpaid Base Salary and the earned Annual Incentive part of the consideration for the release and says the executive is not entitled to them without signing. An employer may not require a release of a claim for wages due unless those wages have been paid.
quotes: In exchange for the Executive's release and other promises in this Separation Agreement, the Company will pay the Executive (a) all Base Salary earned through the Separation Date that has not yet been paid, (b) any Annual Incentive earned for the Fiscal Year completed before the Separation Date that has not yet been paid
The Executive agrees that the Executive is not entitled to any of the payments in this paragraph 2 unless the Executive signs this Separation Agreement.

defects.title: Separation agreement gags statements about workplace conduct and allows 48 hours to sign with no attorney advisory
defects.why: Exhibit A, paragraph 8 bars any statement about workplace conduct, including conduct believed unlawful, and paragraph 10 gives 48 hours to sign; the form never tells the executive of the right to consult an attorney. A separation agreement may not prohibit disclosure of information about unlawful acts in the workplace, and the employer must give notice of the right to consult an attorney and at least five business days.
quotes: The Executive shall not make any statement, to any person and by any means, about conduct in the workplaces of the Company or its Communities, including any claimed harassment, discrimination, retaliation, resident care concern or other conduct that the Executive believes was unlawful
The Executive must sign and return this Separation Agreement within forty-eight (48) hours after the Delivery Time.
